prompt_data.main_prompt: A celestial T-shirt design featuring a cosmic explorer embarking on an ethereal journey through the stars, surrounded by mesmerizing galaxy elements and vibrant space colors. The composition showcases a balanced blend of visual interest and legibility, with a focus on intricate star patterns and deep purples complementing cosmic blues and starlight whites. Typography should be clear and modern, evoking a sense of adventure and wonder.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid excessive noise or blurriness, poor color balance, overly complex compositions, and unrecognizable elements that don't effectively convey the concept on a T-shirt.
